newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's TV Azteca to file lawsuit against NBC.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's TV Azteca to file lawsuit against NBC.

text.p: Mexico's television network TV Azteca said Wednesday it is to file a lawsuit against the U.S. company National Broadcasting Co (NBC), a unit of General Electric Corp Co.
Azteca, a closely held Mexican company, said the suit was for allegedly failing to fullfill terms of the joint venture the companies had agreed upon on May 6, 1994.
Azteca had been bidding to prevent NBC from exercising rights to take a 10 percent stake in the Mexican company and said the civil lawsuit would achieve that goal.
"The U.S. company will thus lose the possibility of participating in the share capital of the Mexican television company," Azteca said in a statement.
"Both parties agreed that the lawsuit will be processed in the International Trade Chamber in Paris, France, in the next months, once preliminary requirements have been fullfilled," Azteca said.

TV Azteca and NBC signed a joint venture contract in 1994 for the U.S. broadcaster to provide sales, programming, production, technology and systems advice to Azteca and a contract for NBC to exercise the option to buy a 10 percent stake in the Mexican company.
